description.value: Tell Your Friends Cafe sits on the pier by the Bowen Island ferry terminal, making it a natural first or last stop for cyclists arriving or departing by boat. The menu leans heavily on local Bowen Island producers, with house-made sourdough sandwiches and ingredients from nearby suppliers like Miller's Meatcraft butcher. Online ordering with ferry-side pickup makes it easy to grab a meal without lingering.

address.value: 400 Bowen Island Trunk Road, Bowen Island, BC V0N 1G0

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: shed (16 spaces, covered, secure) at 47m. Total: 16 spaces, 16 secure.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the OSM address at 400 Bowen Island Trunk Road, adding the postal code V0N 1G0. The online ordering page explicitly offers pickup, and the menu labels multiple items as vegan, GF, and vegetarian. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities was found anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM name is all-lowercase ('tell your friends cafe'); website uses title case ('Tell Your Friends Cafe') — likely a data-entry style difference, not a true name discrepancy.
OSM phone field is empty; phone number (778) 929-7393 sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone is null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open cafe at the Bowen Island ferry pier with an active website and online ordering — an obvious stop for cyclists using the ferry.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple menu items explicitly labeled: Granola Parfait (vegan + GF), Chickpea Sandwich (vegan), Chickpea Salad (GF, vegan option without feta), Curried Coconut Carrot Soup (vegan), Halloumi Sandwich - VEGAN
